'''Renlo''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who vowed to capture [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. He invested in the best technology and devices [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] could buy, and hired private instructors to give himself an edge. Fifteen [[Standard month/Legends|months]] following his preparation, Renlo had been soundly defeated by Solo, and left with no choice but to work as a cleaner in the [["Arc of Fire" Bar & Grill]] on [[Selenius VII]]. He constantly muttered "Almost had 'im" over and over again and was jokingly called "Solo's Bane" by the other hunters that frequented the bar.<ref name="AHI" />
